paths.better-sqlite3: Direct better-sqlite3 imports are forbidden in apps/mem-claw/src/**. Open SQLite via the encrypted chokepoint in @/storage/sqlite-runtime (which routes through @snoai/sno-station-core-crypto). See design.md D11.
paths.better-sqlite3-multiple-ciphers: Direct better-sqlite3-multiple-ciphers imports are forbidden in apps/mem-claw/src/**. Use the chokepoint in @/storage/sqlite-runtime; @snoai/sno-station-core-crypto owns the cipher driver.
